cards.name: Alerts Orbit
cards.summary: Active-alert summary and short, labeled rows.
cards.invariants: All active/problem states remain visible; inactive rows follow show_inactive. No false all-clear from unknown sensors.

cards.name: Battery Orbit
cards.summary: Icon/name/value rows, thin battery bars, persistent low/charging indicators.
cards.invariants: Keep every configured battery and its original unit/state; do not replace the list with an average.

cards.name: Fan Orbit
cards.summary: Name, actual state/speed, power and supported speed control.
cards.invariants: Presets, direction and oscillation in Details only where already supported. Preserve service/read-only guards.

cards.name: NAS Orbit
cards.summary: Name/status, paired CPU/memory and a labeled thin storage usage bar.
cards.invariants: Drive bays and additional thermal/storage telemetry expand; explicit Wake stays available. Preserve matched storage scope and NAS identity.

cards.name: Person Orbit
cards.summary: Small avatar/name/presence header and existing two-column icon/value readings.
cards.invariants: Keep every configured battery/ETA/extra reading and full values/units. Retain verified half-phone paired geometry; no return to the old 200px single-column fallback.

cards.name: Room Orbit
cards.summary: Refine the already-small icon/name, readings/activity and up to four shortcuts; remove redundant decoration.
cards.invariants: Existing details retain full names. Preserve separate navigation/shortcut/More Info hit regions and actual climate/humidifier action. Baseline already small, so savings may be modest.

cards.name: Scenes Orbit
cards.summary: Short header and responsive labeled buttons instead of tall decorative tiles.
cards.invariants: All configured scenes/scripts accessible; no arbitrary cutoff. Keep armed/confirm/cancel behavior and feedback.

cards.name: Sensor Graph Orbit
cards.summary: Labeled value plus shallow timestamp sparkline per selected sensor.
cards.invariants: Retain independent scales/units, every selected sensor and history window. Full charts can expand without extra history requests.

cards.name: Server Orbit
cards.summary: Host/status, existing power action and up to four paired icon/value metrics with optional thin gauges.
cards.invariants: Detailed labels/gauge context expand; all configured readings and real power/status distinctions preserved. Not merged with NAS.

cards.name: Speedtest Orbit
cards.summary: Download/upload paired and ping in a small labeled row; reduce the large decorative scene.
cards.invariants: Freshness/source context retained; more detail expands without running a speed test or changing discovery.

cards.name: UniFi Orbit
cards.summary: Small network/physical-device/client/traffic summary instead of the full orbit animation.
cards.invariants: Device roster/topology expand, preserving available per-device telemetry and actions. No fabricated counters or new controller access.

cards.name: UniFi Command Center
cards.summary: Distinct compact network-health/traffic/client summary with persistent issue/update indicators.
cards.invariants: Topology, devices and contextual actions in labeled expandable sections. Preserve existing selection/context and keep distinct from UniFi Orbit.

cards.name: Vacuum Commander
cards.summary: Name/activity/battery/progress and supported daily actions; relevant Pause/Stop immediately accessible.
cards.invariants: Map and room chooser expand; preserve real selected map/segment IDs and safeguards. No guessed mappings or test cleaning commands.

cards.name: Weather Orbit
cards.summary: Small conditions/provider temperature header, separate optional measured sensor and compact clock/date.
cards.invariants: Forecast in a compact secondary section/disclosure; preserve count/type/tiles-or-bars, Min/Max and current marker. No source conflation or new subscriptions.

cards.name: Welcome Orbit
cards.summary: Reuse existing compact toolbar/greeting/weather-date chip/settings and collapsible shortcuts.
cards.invariants: Do not invent a competing third layout. Preserve classic/compact YAML, shortcuts_expanded initialization and independent scene/navigation safeguards.

cards.name: Action Button
cards.summary: One short icon/label/status/action row, wrapping when narrow.
cards.invariants: Explicit confirmation/cancel remains visible. A last-press timestamp never becomes an inferred device-on state.

cards.name: AlecoAir Dehumidifier
cards.summary: Name, reported humidity/activity, target humidity and existing main power/target controls.
cards.invariants: Other supported settings in Details. Water/problem warnings stay visible; no inferred modes or expanded command scope.

cards.name: Animated Gate
cards.summary: Small gate glyph with actual state/position and labeled supported Open/Stop/Close.
cards.invariants: Full illustration expands. Moving/unknown indicators stay visible; full-size separated targets, no toggle on background.

cards.name: Climate Control
cards.summary: Inline current/target temperatures, actual HVAC action and supported target steps/power.
cards.invariants: Reuse Adjust controls for mode/preset. Preserve ranges, units/steps, actual idle vs heating semantics and command feedback.

cards.name: Frigate Control
cards.summary: Small snapshot thumbnail beside name/state/motion and configured count readings.
cards.invariants: Full preview/More Info remains available. Preserve aspect ratio and refresh lifecycle; no autoplay or new live stream.

cards.name: Home Connect Washer
cards.summary: Operation/program, slim progress, finish-time context and door/connectivity/problem indicators.
cards.invariants: Temperature/spin/dosing/remote settings and existing controls expand; relevant existing Stop stays immediately discoverable. No new Start behavior.

cards.name: HP Printer
cards.summary: Printer/status and individually labeled thin supply bars instead of a large illustration.
cards.invariants: All available configured supply channels retained; other existing device/paper telemetry expands. No combined misleading ink average.

cards.name: Luma Control
cards.summary: Name/state, existing power action and compact supported brightness control/readout.
cards.invariants: Reuse Adjust controls for color/temperature/effects. Switch mode stays a switch; preserve real RGB and current guards.

cards.name: Pi-hole Control
cards.summary: Blocking/running state, main blocking action, configured queries/blocked summary and active pause countdown.
cards.invariants: Instance selector accessible; groups, maintenance, updates and other counters expand. Keep confirmations and strict instance separation.

cards.name: Sensor Meter
cards.summary: Icon/name/value/unit and optional thin meter in one or two short rows.
cards.invariants: Preserve existing configured precision/min/max. No forced Details button on this already-small tile; retain exact More Info.

cards.name: Switch Control
cards.summary: Inline name/state/explicit power, then only configured power/energy/voltage in tight rows.
cards.invariants: No empty sensor panels. Retain all readings/units and existing service/More Info/feedback behavior.

cards.name: Media Player
cards.summary: Small optional artwork, now-playing title/state, essential supported transport/power and compact volume.
cards.invariants: Seek, sources and secondary metadata in Details; full metadata accessible. Keep touch/control identity and truthful feedback. App/channel browsing is not added by compact design.

cards.name: Temperature & Humidity
cards.summary: Paired named/icon temperature and humidity values/units, with small comfort decoration.
cards.invariants: Preserve precision, independent unavailable states and exact More Info. Legacy living-temperature-card receives the same design.

cards.name: Select Orbit
cards.summary: Short name/current-value header and native dropdown; remove duplicate large status panels.
cards.invariants: Exact options, reported-state distinction and visible pending/error/unknown feedback retained. No invented default option or unlabeled icon-only picker.

cards.name: Number Orbit
cards.summary: Inline reported value/unit with compact slider and full-size +/- targets, or existing box/Apply.
cards.invariants: Keep min/max/step context, draft/feedback, decimal-safe arithmetic, release-to-commit, Escape/cancel and stale-metadata rejection. Do not silently change control mode.
